## Description

CASH_SESSION: opening float, counted denominations (INR/AED sets), expected cash from receipts, summary by method (cash, UPI settled, card batch, refunds, insurer receivable), variance. Any variance requires a note and a second staff member's confirmation ("Attention · cash short ₹200"). Close produces a shift report PDF.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Expected cash equals the sum of cash receipts minus cash refunds plus float (test).
- [ ] **AC2.** Closing with variance ≠ 0 requires a note and a second, different staff user's confirmation.
- [ ] **AC3.** Closed sessions are immutable; corrections create an adjustment entry.
- [ ] **AC4.** Pilot clinics close with zero unexplained variance for 10 consecutive days (exit gate 1, tracked in MDV-P4-033).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
